{{Quote|Your would-be husband spent a year in a penal colony on Garen IV after he was kidnapped and dumped there with a false ID.|Altronel learns of Makintay's time in the colony from Rebels|<ref name="FAJ8" />}}
A '''penal colony''' belonging to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garen IV/Legends|Garen IV]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="FAJ8" /> In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="Date Note">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of {{JournalCite|8|Firepower}} to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. "Firerpower" states that [[Stevan Makintay]] was [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] in the colony five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the events of the story, which equates to [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].</ref> the heir to the [[Hargeevan royal family|throne]] of the planet [[Hargeeva]], [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Stevan Makintay]], was [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] in the colony by his [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Makintay]], for deciding to [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] the lowborn [[Ketrian Altronel]]. A [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the lord's incarceration, he was freed during a [[Raid on Garen IV|raid]] on the colony by members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="FAJ8" />

==Behind the scenes==
The colony was mentioned in "[[Firepower]]," a short story written by [[Carolyn Golledge]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 8|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 8]], which was released in [[November]] [[1995]].<ref name="FAJ8" />
